scope: Four actual alternative static repair PNGs inspected; two exact b variants selected for bounded testing. No provider call, actual repaired motion or final adoption approved.

pairs.observed: Established adult Yaro: tousled brown hair, blue-grey eyes, light stubble, leather jacket/burgundy shirt and round silver disc without cross. One black microphone is visibly clasped by a support clip, connected via bolted pivot to a rigid boom exiting lowerleft; its flexible cable is separate and plugged into the rear. Both hands and all grips are below the crop. A modestly opened preparatory jaw has coherent lips/one tooth edge and visible microphone-mouth separation. Neck/shoulders remain connected. Blue curtain/truss/amber-cyan beams persist; no exposed empty drum kit or ghost player is shown.
pairs.motion_limits_or_required_fix: Source supports a bounded new test, not an inferred repair success. Preserve the visible rigid mic/clip/pivot/boom and separate cable, with hands remaining outside framing. Use genuinely chronological mouth/jaw openings and closures for the exact supplied phrase rather than holding the preparatory pose. Preserve identity, connected neck, round disc and fixed curtain geometry. Actual generated support, articulation, camera behaviour and song-paced joins require a new review.
